column1: In government laboratories and elsewhere, scientists are seeking a drug able to prolong life and youthful vigor.
column2: 在政府实验室和其他地方，科学家们正在寻找一种既能延长寿命、又能让青春活力保持得更久的药物。

column1: Studies of caloric restriction are showing the way
column2: 关于热量限制的研究正在揭示其中的奥秘。

column1: As researchers on aging noted recently, no treatment on the market today has been proved to slow human aging - the build-up of molecular and cellular damage that increases vulnerability to infirmity as we grow older.
column2: 正如衰老研究人员近来所指出的，目前市面上还没有任何疗法被证实能延缓人的衰老。这里说的衰老是指，分子和细胞损伤逐渐积累，使我们随着年龄增长更容易变得虚弱。
column3: researchers on aging|衰老研究人员

column1: But one intervention, consumption of a low-calorie yet nutritionally balanced diet, works incredibly well in a broad range of animals, increasing longevity and prolonging good health.
column2: 不过，有一种干预措施对许多种动物都格外有效。这就是在限制热量摄入的同时保持饮食营养均衡，它能延长寿命，也能让动物保持健康的时间更长。
column9: a broad range of|多种多样的

column1: Those findings suggest that caloric restriction could delay aging and increase longevity in humans, too.
column2: 这些发现表明，热量限制可能延缓人类衰老并延长寿命。

column1: Unfortunately, for maximum benefit, people would probably have to reduce their caloric intake by roughly thirty per cent, equivalent to dropping from 2,500 calories a day to 1,750.
column2: 遗憾的是，为了获得最大的好处，人们可能需要将每日摄入的热量减少大约30%，也就是说，每天的热量摄入量需要从2,500卡路里减少到1,750卡路里。

column1: Few mortals could stick to that harsh a regimen, especially for years on end.
column2: 很少有人能坚持如此严苛的饮食方案，尤其是要一连坚持好几年。
column9: for years on end|连续多年

column1: But what if someone could create a pill that mimicked the physiological effects of eating less without actually forcing people to eat less?
column2: 但是，假如有人能制成一种药丸，既能模拟少吃带来的生理效应，又无须真的迫使人们少吃，那会怎样呢？

column1: Could such a ‘caloric-restriction mimetic’, as we call it, enable people to stay healthy longer, postponing age-related disorders (such as diabetes, arteriosclerosis, heart disease and cancer) until very late in life?
column2: 我们把这种物质叫作“热量限制模拟物”。它有没有可能让人更长久地保持健康，将糖尿病、动脉硬化、心脏病和癌症等与年龄有关的疾病推迟到人生的最后阶段才出现？
column8: age-related disorders|与年龄有关的疾病
column13: very late in life|在人生的最后阶段

column1: Scientists first posed this question in the mid-1990s, after researchers came upon a chemical agent that in rodents seemed to reproduce many of caloric restriction’s benefits.
column2: 科学家们在20世纪90年代中期首次提出了这个问题。当时，研究人员发现了一种化学物质，它在啮齿动物身上似乎能够重现热量限制带来的诸多益处。

column1: No compound that would safely achieve the same feat in people has been found yet, but the search has been informative and has fanned hope that caloric-restriction (CR) mimetics can indeed be developed eventually.
column2: 迄今还没有找到能在人身上安全取得相同效果的化合物，但探索过程带来了有益的发现，也让人们更加期待：最终确实有望研制出模拟热量限制（CR）效果的物质。
column5: achieve the same feat|取得同样的成效
column8: informative|adj. 提供了有益信息的

column1: The benefits of caloric restriction
column2: 热量限制的益处

column1: The hunt for CR mimetics grew out of a desire to better understand caloric restriction’s many effects on the body.
column2: 寻找模拟热量限制效应的药物的探索，源于人们对热量限制对身体多种影响的深入理解。

column1: Scientists first recognized the value of the practice more than 60 years ago, when they found that rats fed a low-calorie diet lived longer on average than free-feeding rats and also had a reduced incidence of conditions that become increasingly common in old age.
column2: 早在60多年前，科学家就首次认识到了这种做法的价值。当时他们发现，喂食低热量饮食的大鼠平均寿命比自由进食的大鼠更长，而且一些随年龄增长愈发常见的疾病，在前一组大鼠中的发病率也更低。

column1: What is more, some of the treated animals survived longer than the oldest-living animals in the control group, which means that the maximum lifespan (the oldest attainable age), not merely the normal lifespan, increased.
column2: 此外，一些经过治疗的动物存活时间超过了对照组中寿命最长的个体，这意味着最大寿命——即可达到的最长寿年龄——已真正延长，而不仅仅是正常寿命的提升。

column1: Various interventions, such as infection-fighting drugs, can increase a population’s average survival time, but only approaches that slow the body’s rate of aging will increase the maximum lifespan.
column2: 各种干预措施，如抗感染药物，可以延长人群的平均生存时间，但只有能减缓身体衰老速度的方法，才能延长最大寿命。

column1: The rat findings have been replicated many times and extended to creatures ranging from yeast to fruit flies, worms, fish, spiders, mice and hamsters.
column2: 这些关于老鼠的研究结果已经被多次验证，并且其应用范围还扩展到了从酵母到果蝇、蠕虫、鱼类、蜘蛛、老鼠以及仓鼠等多种生物身上。

column1: Until fairly recently, the studies were limited to short-lived creatures genetically distant from humans.
column2: 直到不久前，这些研究的对象还仅限于寿命短、在遗传上与人类亲缘关系较远的生物。

column1: But caloric-restriction projects underway in two species more closely related to humans - rhesus and squirrel monkeys - have made scientists optimistic that CR mimetics could help people.
column2: 不过，目前正对两种与人类亲缘关系较近的猴开展热量限制研究，分别是恒河猴和松鼠猴。这些研究使科学家乐观地认为，模拟热量限制作用的物质可能对人有益。
column4: projects underway|正在进行的研究项目
column6: more closely related to|与……亲缘关系更近
column11: CR mimetics|模拟热量限制作用的物质

column1: The monkey projects demonstrate that, compared with control animals that eat normally, caloric-restricted monkeys have lower body temperatures and levels of the pancreatic hormone insulin, and they retain more youthful levels of certain hormones that tend to fall with age.
column2: 猴子实验表明，与正常进食的对照动物相比，摄入热量受限的猴子体温较低，胰腺分泌的胰岛素水平也较低。某些激素通常会随年龄增长而下降，而这些猴子的此类激素仍保持在更接近年轻时的水平。
column17: fall with age|随年龄增长而下降

column1: The caloric-restricted animals also look better on indicators of risk for age-related diseases.
column2: 热量限制的动物在与年龄相关疾病风险的指标上表现更好。

column1: For example, they have lower blood pressure and triglyceride levels (signifying a decreased likelihood of heart disease), and they have more normal blood glucose levels (pointing to a reduced risk for diabetes, which is marked by unusually high blood glucose levels).
column2: 例如，它们的血压和甘油三酯水平均更低，这意味着患心脏病的可能性降低。它们的血糖水平也更接近正常，表明患糖尿病的风险较低；血糖异常升高正是糖尿病的特征。

column1: Further, it has recently been shown that rhesus monkeys kept on caloric-restricted diets for an extended time (nearly 15 years) have less chronic disease.
column2: 此外，最近的研究表明，长期遵循热量限制饮食的恒河猴，其慢性疾病的发病率显著更低。这些猴子的饮食限制持续时间接近15年。

column1: They and the other monkeys must be followed still longer, however, to know whether low-calorie intake can increase both average and maximum lifespans in monkeys.
column2: 然而，为了确定低热量摄入是否能同时延长猴子的平均寿命和最大寿命，仍需对它们及其他猴子进行更长时间的追踪观察。

column1: Unlike the multitude of elixirs being touted as the latest anti-aging cure, CR mimetics would alter fundamental processes that underlie aging.
column2: 与那些被宣传为最新抗衰老疗法的各种灵药不同，CR仿生剂能够改变导致衰老的基本过程。

column1: We aim to develop compounds that fool cells into activating maintenance and repair.
column2: 我们的目标是开发出能够欺骗细胞进行维护与修复活动的化合物。

column1: How a prototype caloric-restriction mimetic works
column2: 一种模拟热量限制的原型药物是如何起作用的

column1: The best-studied candidate for a caloric-restriction mimetic, 2DG (2-deoxy-D-glucose), works by interfering with the way cells process glucose.
column2: 在有望模拟热量限制效果的物质中，研究最充分的是2DG（2-脱氧-D-葡萄糖）。它通过干扰细胞处理葡萄糖的方式起作用。

column1: It has proved toxic at some doses in animals and so cannot be used in humans.
column2: 动物研究已证实，它在某些剂量下有毒，因此不能用于人体。

column1: But it has demonstrated that chemicals can replicate the effects of caloric restriction; the trick is finding the right one.
column2: 不过，它表明化学物质可以模拟限制热量摄入的效果；关键是找对那种物质。
column9: the right one|合适的那一种

column1: Cells use the glucose from food to generate ATP (adenosine triphosphate), the molecule that powers many activities in the body.
column2: 细胞利用食物中的葡萄糖生成ATP（三磷酸腺苷），这种分子为体内许多活动供能。

column1: By limiting food intake, caloric restriction minimizes the amount of glucose entering cells and decreases ATP generation.
column2: 限制热量摄入是通过减少进食量，把进入细胞的葡萄糖量降到最低，同时减少ATP的生成。

column1: When 2DG is administered to animals that eat normally, glucose reaches cells in abundance but the drug prevents most of it from being processed and thus reduces ATP synthesis.
column2: 正常进食的动物用上2DG时，仍有大量葡萄糖进入细胞，但这种药物使其中大部分不能被代谢，从而减少了ATP的合成。
column9: most of it|其中的大部分

column1: Researchers have proposed several explanations for why interruption of glucose processing and ATP production might retard aging.
column2: 为什么干扰葡萄糖代谢和ATP生成可能延缓衰老？研究人员对此提出了几种解释。

column1: One possibility relates to the ATP-making machinery’s emission of free radicals, which are thought to contribute to aging and to such age-related diseases as cancer by damaging cells.
column2: 一种可能的解释与产生ATP的系统释放自由基有关。人们认为，自由基会损伤细胞，从而促成衰老，还会促成癌症等与年龄有关的疾病。

column1: Reduced operation of the machinery should limit their production and thereby constrain the damage.
column2: 这套系统的运转减弱，应该会减少自由基的产生，从而限制细胞受到的损伤。

column1: Another hypothesis suggests that decreased processing of glucose could indicate to cells that food is scarce (even if it isn’t) and induce them to shift into an anti-aging mode that emphasizes preservation of the organism over such ‘luxuries’ as growth and reproduction.
column2: 另一种假说认为，葡萄糖代谢减少可能向细胞传递食物短缺的信号（即使实际上并不短缺），使细胞转入一种抗衰老模式。在这种模式下，维持机体生存优先于生长和繁殖之类的“奢侈”活动。
